objective: Turn cumulative learning from documentation into an executable, auditable project lifecycle.

baseline.description: Scientific validation gate and engineering controls existed; cumulative learning was not yet enforced by a machine-readable lifecycle contract.

scientific_validity.reason: This process change does not constitute external scientific benchmark evidence.

measurement.trade_off: No scientific-gate relaxation; external benchmark completion remains release-blocking.

evidence: GitHub Actions CI run for merged PR #72

findings: Lifecycle requirements can be made executable without weakening the scientific gate.
Machine-readable cycle records are required for auditable cumulative process enforcement.
